context: Two coworkers prepare for a board meeting with data backups
purpose: Teach: 総額/前年/出資/議事/モニター/ユニット/基づき/バックアップ

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 結城さん、明日の取締役会のモニター画面、ちゃんと映りますかね？
lines.en: Yuki, will the monitor screen for tomorrow's board meeting display properly?
lines.style: Slightly anxious senior coworker checking equipment before an important presentation.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: さっき会議室で確認しました。各ユニットごとの売上資料も全部読み込めています。
lines.en: I checked in the meeting room earlier. The sales materials for each unit all load fine.
lines.style: Calm and reassuring junior reporting back with crisp professional tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 助かります。前年同期と比べた数字に基づき、社長が話を進めるみたいなので。
lines.en: Thanks, that helps. The president will speak based on year-over-year comparison figures.
lines.style: Grateful manager explaining the meeting flow to a colleague.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: なるほど。じゃあ出資者向けの総額のスライドも入れておいた方がいいですよね？
lines.en: I see. Then we should include the total-amount slide for the investors too, right?
lines.style: Thoughtful coworker suggesting an addition with rising clarifying intonation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ぜひお願いします。それと、議事録用にもう一台ノートパソコン用意できますか？
lines.en: Yes, please. Also, can you prepare one more laptop for taking the minutes?
lines.style: Polite request layered with mild urgency from a busy senior.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: もちろんです。あ、念のため外付けハードにバックアップも取っておきますね。
lines.en: Of course. Just to be safe, I'll also back everything up onto an external drive.
lines.style: Proactive employee anticipating risks with a soft considerate tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 本当に頼りになります。去年みたいにデータが飛んだら、もう冷や汗ものですから。
lines.en: You're really dependable. If the data crashed like last year, I'd break out in cold sweat.
lines.style: Relieved warm praise mixed with a self-deprecating laugh about past trouble.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: あの時は焦りましたよね。今回は大丈夫、ゆっくりお茶でも飲んでてください。
lines.en: That time was really stressful, wasn't it. We're fine this round, so relax and have some tea.
lines.style: Warm laughing reassurance closing the conversation on a friendly note.
